Name: PHANTOM_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines the color and transparency of phantom visual effects

Fields.Name: Edge Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the edge (rim) colour, sent to the phantom shader as is with Edge Color R/G/B.

Fields.Name: Front Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the front (facing) colour, sent to the phantom shader as is with Front Color R/G/B.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the diffuse multiplier colour, sent to the phantom shader as is.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the specular multiplier colour, sent to the phantom shader as is.

Fields.Name: Light Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the light colour, sent to the phantom shader as is.

Fields.Name: Edge Color: R
Fields.Description: Edge (rim) colour, red: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Edge Color: G
Fields.Description: Edge (rim) colour, green: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Edge Color: B
Fields.Description: Edge (rim) colour, blue: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Front Color: R
Fields.Description: Front (facing) colour, red: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Front Color: G
Fields.Description: Front (facing) colour, green: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Front Color: B
Fields.Description: Front (facing) colour, blue: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: R
Fields.Description: Diffuse multiplier colour, red: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1. 255: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: G
Fields.Description: Diffuse multiplier colour, green: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1. 255: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: B
Fields.Description: Diffuse multiplier colour, blue: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1. 255: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: R
Fields.Description: Specular multiplier colour, red: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1. 255: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: G
Fields.Description: Specular multiplier colour, green: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1. 255: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: B
Fields.Description: Specular multiplier colour, blue: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1. 255: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Light Color: R
Fields.Description: Light colour, red: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Light Color: G
Fields.Description: Light colour, green: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Light Color: B
Fields.Description: Light colour, blue: 0-255, sent to the shader as 0-1.

Fields.Name: Overall Alpha
Fields.Description: Overall opacity of the phantom, sent to the shader. 1: opaque, 0: invisible.

Fields.Name: Blend Rate
Fields.Description: The blend ratio.

Fields.Name: Blend Type
Fields.Description: Blend mode of the phantom shader, 0-3.

Fields.Name: Perform Edge Color Subtraction
Fields.Description: If set, the shader subtracts the edge colour instead of adding it.

Fields.Name: Perform Front Color Subtraction
Fields.Description: If set, the shader subtracts the front colour instead of adding it.

Fields.Name: Is 1 Pass Only
Fields.Description: Do you not do 2pass?
